title: Audit Toggle filter visual depth
description: Audit Toggle for switch anatomy, on/off labels, boolean binding, icon support, size, alignment, states, and URL/reset behavior.
objective: Make Toggle trustworthy for boolean fields instead of a styled checkbox with unclear semantics.
expected_outputs: Boolean value and compare behavior map
acceptance_criteria: The audit identifies how Toggle binds to boolean, numeric, text, or taxonomy-like values.
The audit covers on/off label placement, knob shape, track styling, icons, sizes, and alignment.
The audit checks whether reset and URL sync restore the correct off state.
The audit identifies whether toggle controls should be shared with checkbox or own their own section.
verification: Source-backed findings cite render, CSS, JS, and control IDs.
No Toggle implementation is made by this task.
risks: Toggle can be visually clear but data-fragile if its true/false value contract is not explicit.
